bug_description: order list page keeps loading forever when the connection drops.

screenshot.description: Page showing an endless spinner over the order list.

steps_to_reproduce: Disable the network in DevTools and reload
root_cause: The loading flag is reset only in the success branch, not when the promise rejects.
resolution: Reset the loading state in a finally block and show an error message with a retry button.

bug_description: Hi team, admin page returns forbidden for SSO accounts. Please fix ASAP.

screenshot.description: Admin page showing '403 Forbidden' for a user who is an admin.

root_cause: The role claim is missing from the JWT issued through the SSO flow, so authorization falls back to 'user'.
resolution: Map SSO groups to application roles when issuing the token and add a test for SSO logins.

bug_description: Hello, large file (20 MB) upload is rejected. I tried clearing the cache but it did not help.

screenshot.description: Upload dialog showing 'Upload failed' for a 20 MB file.

root_cause: The reverse proxy limits the request body to 5 MB while the UI allows up to 20 MB.
resolution: Align the proxy and application limits and add a client-side size check with a clear message.

bug_description: Bug: Coupon SAVE10 is applied twice and the total is too low. Not sure if it is related to my account.

screenshot.description: Order summary showing the SAVE10 discount line twice.

steps_to_reproduce: Add items to the cart on https://admin.fleetly.dev/cart
Observe the discount is applied again
root_cause: The discount is calculated in both the cart service and the checkout service because the 'applied' flag is not persisted.
resolution: Apply discounts in one pricing service and persist the applied state.

bug_description: [/reset-password] The password reset link still works after it has been used. Please fix ASAP.

screenshot.description: Reset password page opened a second time with the same link.

steps_to_reproduce: Open the link on https://learn.edu-demo.org/reset-password and set a new password
root_cause: The reset token is not invalidated after use.
resolution: Make tokens single-use, store a used flag and invalidate older tokens.

bug_description: Hi team, some products appear on two pages when paginating. I tried clearing the cache but it did not help.

screenshot.description: Two pages of results showing the same product card.

steps_to_reproduce: Observe items that were also on page 1
root_cause: The query sorts by created_at without a tie-breaker, so rows with equal timestamps swap order between requests.
resolution: Add a unique secondary sort key (id) to the ORDER BY clause.

bug_description: Urgent: The password reset link still works after it has been used. This happens every time.

screenshot.description: Reset password page opened a second time with the same link.

steps_to_reproduce: Open the link on https://learn.edu-demo.org/reset-password and set a new password
root_cause: The reset token is not invalidated after use.
resolution: Make tokens single-use, store a used flag and invalidate older tokens.

bug_description: Hello, dark theme: form labels has very low contrast.

screenshot.description: Dashboard in dark mode with dark grey form labels on a black background.

steps_to_reproduce: Switch the theme to Dark in settings
root_cause: The form labels uses a hard-coded color (#333) instead of the theme color token.
resolution: Replace the hard-coded color with the theme token and verify WCAG AA contrast.

bug_description: [/checkout] Cart total differs by one cent from the sum of line items. It happens intermittently.

screenshot.description: Checkout with total 49.99 while the invoice shows 50.00.

steps_to_reproduce: Add 3 items with price 14.99 on https://app.acme-saas.io/checkout
root_cause: Floating point arithmetic is used for money, and rounding is applied per line in one place and per total in another.
resolution: Use integer cents or Decimal and apply a single rounding rule.

bug_description: Urgent: The 'Address picker' modal cannot be closed on mobile; the X button does not respond. This happens every time.

screenshot.description: Mobile screenshot with the 'Address picker' modal covering the screen.

console_logs: Uncaught TypeError: modal.close is not a function
steps_to_reproduce: Open https://admin.fleetly.dev/orders on a mobile device
Tap the X button in the corner
Observe that the modal remains open
root_cause: The mobile browser version lacks HTMLDialogElement.close() and no polyfill is loaded, so the close handler throws.
resolution: Add a dialog polyfill or use a custom close method that toggles the open state.

bug_description: Since this morning: Monthly renewal shifts to a different day after Aug 31. Started after the last update.

screenshot.description: Billing page with the next payment date that is not the end of the month.

root_cause: The next date is calculated by adding 30 days instead of a calendar month.
resolution: Use a calendar-aware 'add one month' function that clamps to the last day of the month.

bug_description: Hello, payments are recorded twice in the admin panel.

screenshot.description: Admin payment list with two identical rows.

console_logs: (server log) WARN webhook event evt_a91f processed twice
steps_to_reproduce: Wait for the payment provider webhook
root_cause: The webhook endpoint has no idempotency check, and the provider retries delivery after a slow response.
resolution: Store processed event IDs and ignore repeated deliveries; respond quickly and process asynchronously.

bug_description: FYI - Search with accents/special characters ('café') shows empty list.

screenshot.description: Search page showing 'No results for café'.

root_cause: The server decodes the query string as Latin-1 instead of UTF-8, so non-ASCII terms never match.
resolution: Decode the query as UTF-8 and add tests with non-ASCII characters.

bug_description: Hi team, search shows an error after typing quickly. I tried clearing the cache but it did not help.

screenshot.description: Search box with 'Too many requests, try again later'.

steps_to_reproduce: Observe 429 responses and a failed search
root_cause: The client sends a request on every keystroke and retries immediately with no exponential backoff.
resolution: Debounce input and implement exponential backoff on 429 responses.

bug_description: The help icon tooltip is hidden under the dialog.

screenshot.description: Modal open with the help icon tooltip partially visible behind it.

steps_to_reproduce: Observe the tooltip is behind the modal
root_cause: Tooltip z-index (1000) is lower than the modal overlay z-index (1050).
resolution: Raise the tooltip z-index above the modal layer or render it in a top-level portal.

bug_description: Urgent: Double-clicking the submit button creates two payments. I tried clearing the cache but it did not help.

screenshot.description: Confirmation page opened twice with different IDs.

root_cause: The button is not disabled during submission and the server has no idempotency key.
resolution: Disable the button while pending and add an idempotency key on the server.

steps_to_reproduce: Register on https://admin.fleetly.dev/signup with user@mail.com and use the trial

root_cause: The reverse proxy limits the request body to 5 MB while the UI allows up to 20 MB.
resolution: Align the proxy and application limits and add a client-side size check with a clear message.

bug_description: Cannot create a new record via /api/orders if the address2 field is blank.

screenshot.description: Error toast 'Something went wrong' after submitting with an empty address2.

console_logs: Uncaught (in promise) Error: Request failed with status code 500
root_cause: The server dereferences the optional field 'address2', which is null when left empty (NullPointerException).
resolution: Validate input and default 'address2' to an empty string; add a unit test for null input.

bug_description: Urgent: The sticky footer covers the last row of the list. Not sure if it is related to my account.

screenshot.description: Bottom of the list partially hidden behind a fixed footer.

steps_to_reproduce: Scroll to the bottom of the list
Observe the last row is hidden
root_cause: The fixed footer has no matching bottom padding on the content container.
resolution: Add padding-bottom equal to the footer height or use a sticky layout.

bug_description: Since this morning: Large file (8 MB) upload is rejected. Reproduced by two colleagues.

screenshot.description: Upload dialog showing 'Upload failed' for a 8 MB file.

root_cause: The reverse proxy limits the request body to 5 MB while the UI allows up to 20 MB.
resolution: Align the proxy and application limits and add a client-side size check with a clear message.

bug_description: Hello, the report page times out when selecting the last 12 months.

screenshot.description: Report page with the message 'Request timed out'.

root_cause: The query filters on 'created_at' which has no index, causing a full table scan.
resolution: Add an index on 'created_at' and paginate or pre-aggregate the report data.

bug_description: Since this morning: Late evening orders appear on the next day's report (UTC+9).

screenshot.description: Daily report where 23:30 orders are listed under the next date.

steps_to_reproduce: Create an order at 23:30 local time
Observe the order under the next day

bug_description: Dark theme: form labels has very low contrast. I tried clearing the cache but it did not help.

steps_to_reproduce: Switch the theme to Dark in settings
root_cause: The form labels uses a hard-coded color (#333) instead of the theme color token.
resolution: Replace the hard-coded color with the theme token and verify WCAG AA contrast.

bug_description: [/checkout] Submitting the form fails with a server error when 'coupon' is left empty.

bug_description: Hello, images do not load on the category page (broken icon shown for banner). Not sure if it is related to my account.

bug_description: FYI - Subscription renewal date is wrong for users who subscribed on Mar 31. It happens intermittently.

screenshot.description: Billing page with the next payment date that is not the end of the month.

root_cause: The next date is calculated by adding 30 days instead of a calendar month.
resolution: Use a calendar-aware 'add one month' function that clamps to the last day of the month.

bug_description: Bug: Prices shown in EUR are different on the checkout and the invoice. It happens intermittently.

steps_to_reproduce: Compare the checkout total with the invoice
root_cause: The already converted amount is passed through the currency conversion again at the invoice step.
resolution: Store amounts in the base currency and convert once at display time.

bug_description: Since this morning: The password reset link still works after it has been used. Not sure if it is related to my account.

steps_to_reproduce: Open the link on https://shop.example.com/reset-password and set a new password

resolution: Make tokens single-use, store a used flag and invalidate older tokens.

bug_description: Bug: After logout I can still open private pages with the back button/old token. Started after the last update.

screenshot.description: Account page still visible after logging out.

steps_to_reproduce: Replay a request with the old session cookie or press Back on https://portal.demo-bank.vn/logout
Observe private data is still returned
root_cause: Logout only clears the client cookie; the server session is not destroyed.
resolution: Invalidate the session/token on the server at logout and send no-store cache headers.

bug_description: Since this morning: Search with accents/special characters ('Müller') shows empty list.

screenshot.description: Search page showing 'No results for Müller'.

root_cause: The server decodes the query string as Latin-1 instead of UTF-8, so non-ASCII terms never match.
resolution: Decode the query as UTF-8 and add tests with non-ASCII characters.

bug_description: Hi team, payments are recorded twice in the admin panel.

screenshot.description: Admin payment list with two identical rows.

console_logs: (server log) WARN webhook event evt_a91f processed twice
steps_to_reproduce: Wait for the payment provider webhook
root_cause: The webhook endpoint has no idempotency check, and the provider retries delivery after a slow response.
resolution: Store processed event IDs and ignore repeated deliveries; respond quickly and process asynchronously.

bug_description: Since this morning: Overselling of a limited product during a flash sale. Not sure if it is related to my account.

screenshot.description: Product page showing 'Stock: -2'.

steps_to_reproduce: Buy the last item in both at the same time
root_cause: Stock is updated with read-modify-write without locking, so concurrent orders overwrite each other.
resolution: Use an atomic decrement or row-level locking and reject orders when stock is insufficient.

console_logs: Access to fetch at 'https://api.app.acme-saas.io/v3/data' from origin 'https://app.acme-saas.io' has been blocked by CORS policy: No 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' header is present on the requested resource.

bug_description: Coupon FREESHIP is applied twice and the total is too low. Please fix ASAP.

Observe the discount is applied again

resolution: Apply discounts in one pricing service and persist the applied state.

bug_description: Urgent: Random logout / 401 errors when several widgets load at the same time. It happens intermittently.

screenshot.description: Dashboard showing 'Session expired' while still logged in.

steps_to_reproduce: Wait until the access token expires (15 min)
root_cause: Parallel requests each trigger a token refresh; the first one rotates the refresh token, so the others use a revoked token.
resolution: Implement a single-flight refresh queue so only one refresh request is sent.

bug_description: Hello, the error message for phone number stays visible even after I correct the value. I tried clearing the cache but it did not help.

resolution: Re-run validation on change/blur and clear the error when the value becomes valid.

bug_description: Autocomplete stops working after a few keystrokes.

root_cause: The client sends a request on every keystroke and retries immediately with no exponential backoff.
resolution: Debounce input and implement exponential backoff on 429 responses.

bug_description: New account returns 404 for a few seconds. Started after the last update.

screenshot.description: Profile page with 'User not found' immediately after signing up.

steps_to_reproduce: Get redirected to the profile page
Observe 'User not found'; refresh after 5s works
root_cause: The read request goes to a replica that has not yet received the newly inserted row (replication lag).
resolution: Read from the primary right after writes (read-your-writes) or retry with a short backoff.

bug_description: [/home] App shows a blank page since yesterday's release.

screenshot.description: White screen; DevTools shows an uncaught TypeError.

console_logs: Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toLowerCase')
steps_to_reproduce: Wait for the profile call to finish
root_cause: The backend renamed the response field 'username' without versioning, and the client still reads the old name.
resolution: Restore the old field as an alias, add API contract tests and a deprecation period.

bug_description: [/search] Searching for 'phở bò' returns no results although items exist.

screenshot.description: Search page showing 'No results for phở bò'.

steps_to_reproduce: Type 'phở bò' in the search box
root_cause: The server decodes the query string as Latin-1 instead of UTF-8, so non-ASCII terms never match.
resolution: Decode the query as UTF-8 and add tests with non-ASCII characters.

bug_description: Bug: Submitting the form fails with a server error when 'address2' is left empty. This happens every time.

screenshot.description: Error toast 'Something went wrong' after submitting with an empty address2.

console_logs: Uncaught (in promise) Error: Request failed with status code 500
root_cause: The server dereferences the optional field 'address2', which is null when left empty (NullPointerException).
resolution: Validate input and default 'address2' to an empty string; add a unit test for null input.

bug_description: After logging in I am always sent to the dashboard instead of the page I wanted (/projects/7). Started after the last update.

screenshot.description: Dashboard page opened after login although the user requested /projects/7.

root_cause: The returnUrl parameter is dropped during the SSO redirect so the default route is used.
resolution: Preserve returnUrl in the OAuth state parameter and validate it against an allow list.

bug_description: Since this morning: Tapping the side drawer icon has no visible effect.

screenshot.description: Mobile header where the side drawer flickers and closes.

steps_to_reproduce: Observe it toggles twice and ends closed

resolution: Remove the duplicate listener and register events in one place.

bug_description: Since this morning: The date format in the calendar ignores my language setting (de-DE). It happens intermittently.

bug_description: Bug: Session stays valid on the server after I click Log out. I tried clearing the cache but it did not help.

steps_to_reproduce: Add 3 items with price 14.99 on https://admin.fleetly.dev/checkout
root_cause: Floating point arithmetic is used for money, and rounding is applied per line in one place and per total in another.
resolution: Use integer cents or Decimal and apply a single rounding rule.

bug_description: Double-clicking the submit button creates two registrations.

screenshot.description: Confirmation page opened twice with different IDs.

root_cause: The button is not disabled during submission and the server has no idempotency key.
resolution: Disable the button while pending and add an idempotency key on the server.

bug_description: Some products appear on two pages when paginating. Please fix ASAP.

screenshot.description: Two pages of results showing the same product card.

steps_to_reproduce: Observe items that were also on page 1
root_cause: The query sorts by created_at without a tie-breaker, so rows with equal timestamps swap order between requests.
resolution: Add a unique secondary sort key (id) to the ORDER BY clause.

bug_description: Hello, after logout I can still open private pages with the back button/old token. This happens every time.

screenshot.description: Account page still visible after logging out.

steps_to_reproduce: Replay a request with the old session cookie or press Back on https://app.acme-saas.io/logout
Observe private data is still returned
root_cause: Logout only clears the client cookie; the server session is not destroyed.
resolution: Invalidate the session/token on the server at logout and send no-store cache headers.

bug_description: Hi team, a duplicate registration is created if I click twice quickly. This happens every time.

screenshot.description: Confirmation page opened twice with different IDs.

root_cause: The button is not disabled during submission and the server has no idempotency key.
resolution: Disable the button while pending and add an idempotency key on the server.

bug_description: FYI - Data fails to load on the web app after the latest deployment. This happens every time.

screenshot.description: Page with empty lists and a red CORS error in DevTools.

console_logs: Access to fetch at 'https://api.shop.example.com/v3/data' from origin 'https://shop.example.com' has been blocked by CORS policy: No 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' header is present on the requested resource.
steps_to_reproduce: Observe the empty state and the CORS error
root_cause: The new API gateway route does not include the CORS middleware or the web origin in its allow list.
resolution: Add the web origin to the allowed origins on the gateway route and verify preflight responses.

bug_description: Hi team, the error message for password stays visible even after I correct the value. Not sure if it is related to my account.

screenshot.description: Form with a red error under the password field although the value is valid.

root_cause: The error state is only recomputed on submit, not on the change event.
resolution: Re-run validation on change/blur and clear the error when the value becomes valid.

bug_description: Hi team, the report page times out when selecting the last 12 months.

screenshot.description: Report page with the message 'Request timed out'.

root_cause: The query filters on 'user_id' which has no index, causing a full table scan.
resolution: Add an index on 'user_id' and paginate or pre-aggregate the report data.

bug_description: Hi team, the invoice amount in JPY is wrong; it seems converted twice. Reproduced by two colleagues.

screenshot.description: Invoice total far from the amount shown at checkout in JPY.

resolution: Add padding-bottom equal to the footer height or use a sticky layout.

bug_description: Random logout / 401 errors when several widgets load at the same time.

screenshot.description: Dashboard showing 'Session expired' while still logged in.

steps_to_reproduce: Wait until the access token expires (15 min)
root_cause: Parallel requests each trigger a token refresh; the first one rotates the refresh token, so the others use a revoked token.
resolution: Implement a single-flight refresh queue so only one refresh request is sent.

bug_description: Payments are recorded twice in the admin panel.

console_logs: (server log) WARN webhook event evt_77c2 processed twice
steps_to_reproduce: Wait for the payment provider webhook
root_cause: The webhook endpoint has no idempotency check, and the provider retries delivery after a slow response.
resolution: Store processed event IDs and ignore repeated deliveries; respond quickly and process asynchronously.

bug_description: Monthly renewal shifts to a different day after Aug 31. I tried clearing the cache but it did not help.

bug_description: On my phone the Terms & conditions popup stays on screen and blocks the whole page. Reproduced by two colleagues.

screenshot.description: Mobile screenshot with the 'Terms & conditions' modal covering the screen.

Tap the X button in the corner

root_cause: The mobile browser version lacks HTMLDialogElement.close() and no polyfill is loaded, so the close handler throws.

bug_description: Free trial restarts every time I sign up with a similar email.

bug_description: Hi team, returnUrl is ignored after login. Started after the last update.

screenshot.description: Dashboard page opened after login although the user requested /settings.

root_cause: The returnUrl parameter is dropped during the SSO redirect so the default route is used.
resolution: Preserve returnUrl in the OAuth state parameter and validate it against an allow list.

bug_description: Hello, duplicate items between page 1 and page 2 of the list. Reproduced by two colleagues.

screenshot.description: Two pages of results showing the same product card.

steps_to_reproduce: Observe items that were also on page 1

bug_description: The Save changes button is unresponsive after the page loads.

bug_description: Hi team, search shows an error after typing quickly.

root_cause: The query filters on 'status' which has no index, causing a full table scan.
resolution: Add an index on 'status' and paginate or pre-aggregate the report data.

bug_description: [/signup] The error message for postal code stays visible even after I correct the value.

screenshot.description: Form with a red error under the postal code field although the value is valid.

root_cause: The error state is only recomputed on submit, not on the change event.
resolution: Re-run validation on change/blur and clear the error when the value becomes valid.

bug_description: The category dropdown list is cut off and the last options are not reachable. It happens intermittently.

steps_to_reproduce: Scroll to the bottom of the list
root_cause: The parent container has overflow:hidden, so the absolutely positioned menu is clipped.
resolution: Render the dropdown in a portal attached to document.body or remove overflow:hidden from the parent.

bug_description: FYI - The date format in the calendar ignores my language setting (fr-FR). Reproduced by two colleagues.

screenshot.description: Date picker displaying 10/12/2025 while the account locale is fr-FR.

console_logs: Warning: Failed prop type: Invalid prop `locale` of value `fr-FR` supplied to `DatePicker`.
steps_to_reproduce: Set the account language/region to fr-FR
root_cause: The locale prop is not passed from user settings so the component falls back to en-US.
resolution: Pass the user's locale to the DatePicker and add the matching locale data.

bug_description: Urgent: Data fails to load on the web app after the latest deployment. Please fix ASAP.

screenshot.description: Page with empty lists and a red CORS error in DevTools.

console_logs: Access to fetch at 'https://api.app.acme-saas.io/v2/data' from origin 'https://app.acme-saas.io' has been blocked by CORS policy: No 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' header is present on the requested resource.
steps_to_reproduce: Observe the empty state and the CORS error
root_cause: The new API gateway route does not include the CORS middleware or the web origin in its allow list.
resolution: Add the web origin to the allowed origins on the gateway route and verify preflight responses.

bug_description: Bug: The sticky footer covers the last row of the comment section.

screenshot.description: Bottom of the comment section partially hidden behind a fixed footer.

steps_to_reproduce: Scroll to the bottom of the comment section
Observe the last row is hidden
root_cause: The fixed footer has no matching bottom padding on the content container.
resolution: Add padding-bottom equal to the footer height or use a sticky layout.

bug_description: [/product/limited-edition] Overselling of a limited product during a flash sale. Please fix ASAP.

screenshot.description: Product page showing 'Stock: -2'.

steps_to_reproduce: Buy the last item in both at the same time
root_cause: Stock is updated with read-modify-write without locking, so concurrent orders overwrite each other.
resolution: Use an atomic decrement or row-level locking and reject orders when stock is insufficient.

bug_description: Urgent: Uploading a 6 MB file fails without a clear message. It happens intermittently.

screenshot.description: Upload dialog showing 'Upload failed' for a 6 MB file.

root_cause: The reverse proxy limits the request body to 5 MB while the UI allows up to 20 MB.
resolution: Align the proxy and application limits and add a client-side size check with a clear message.

bug_description: Payments are recorded twice in the admin panel.

screenshot.description: Admin payment list with two identical rows.

console_logs: (server log) WARN webhook event evt_77c2 processed twice
steps_to_reproduce: Wait for the payment provider webhook
root_cause: The webhook endpoint has no idempotency check, and the provider retries delivery after a slow response.
resolution: Store processed event IDs and ignore repeated deliveries; respond quickly and process asynchronously.

bug_description: Urgent: Profile saved successfully but the birthday is back to the old value after reload. Please fix ASAP.

screenshot.description: Profile page with a green 'Saved' toast and the old birthday after refresh.

steps_to_reproduce: Click Save and see the success message
Reload the page and observe the old value
root_cause: The update endpoint whitelists writable fields and 'birthday' was not added to the list, but it still returns 200.
resolution: Add 'birthday' to the writable fields and return 400 for ignored or unknown fields.

bug_description: Since this morning: Overselling of a limited product during a flash sale. I tried clearing the cache but it did not help.

screenshot.description: Product page showing 'Stock: -2'.

steps_to_reproduce: Buy the last item in both at the same time
root_cause: Stock is updated with read-modify-write without locking, so concurrent orders overwrite each other.
resolution: Use an atomic decrement or row-level locking and reject orders when stock is insufficient.

bug_description: On mobile the navigation bar does not fit and covers the text below. This happens every time.

screenshot.description: Mobile view where the navigation bar overlaps the page content.

steps_to_reproduce: Open https://admin.fleetly.dev/pricing on a phone or resize the window below 768px
root_cause: No media query exists for max-width 768px and the navigation bar keeps a fixed width of 960px.
resolution: Add a responsive breakpoint and use fluid widths (flex/grid).

bug_description: Since this morning: Autocomplete stops working after a few keystrokes.

screenshot.description: Search box with 'Too many requests, try again later'.

steps_to_reproduce: Observe 429 responses and a failed search
root_cause: The client sends a request on every keystroke and retries immediately with no exponential backoff.
resolution: Debounce input and implement exponential backoff on 429 responses.

bug_description: Hello, i get 'Unauthorized' on /api/profile shortly after the access token expires.

screenshot.description: Dashboard showing 'Session expired' while still logged in.

steps_to_reproduce: Wait until the access token expires (15 min)
root_cause: Parallel requests each trigger a token refresh; the first one rotates the refresh token, so the others use a revoked token.
resolution: Implement a single-flight refresh queue so only one refresh request is sent.

bug_description: Hi team, search with accents/special characters ('café') shows empty list. Started after the last update.

screenshot.description: Search page showing 'No results for café'.

root_cause: The server decodes the query string as Latin-1 instead of UTF-8, so non-ASCII terms never match.
resolution: Decode the query as UTF-8 and add tests with non-ASCII characters.

bug_description: Urgent: Some products appear on two pages when paginating. Please fix ASAP.

screenshot.description: Two pages of results showing the same product card.

steps_to_reproduce: Observe items that were also on page 1
root_cause: The query sorts by created_at without a tie-breaker, so rows with equal timestamps swap order between requests.
resolution: Add a unique secondary sort key (id) to the ORDER BY clause.

resolution: Store processed event IDs and ignore repeated deliveries; respond quickly and process asynchronously.

bug_description: Hi team, the report page times out when selecting the last 12 months.

screenshot.description: Report page with the message 'Request timed out'.

root_cause: The query filters on 'user_id' which has no index, causing a full table scan.
resolution: Add an index on 'user_id' and paginate or pre-aggregate the report data.

bug_description: Dấu tiếng Việt bị cắt ở button labels (diacritics clipped). I tried clearing the cache but it did not help.

screenshot.description: Vietnamese button labels where the accents on capital letters are clipped.

root_cause: The line-height is set to 1 with overflow hidden so tall diacritics are clipped.
resolution: Use a line-height of at least 1.4 and remove the fixed height.

bug_description: FYI - Double-clicking the submit button creates two registrations.

screenshot.description: Confirmation page opened twice with different IDs.

root_cause: The button is not disabled during submission and the server has no idempotency key.
resolution: Disable the button while pending and add an idempotency key on the server.

bug_description: After logout I can still open private pages with the back button/old token. I tried clearing the cache but it did not help.

screenshot.description: Account page still visible after logging out.

steps_to_reproduce: Replay a request with the old session cookie or press Back on https://shop.example.com/logout
Observe private data is still returned
root_cause: Logout only clears the client cookie; the server session is not destroyed.
resolution: Invalidate the session/token on the server at logout and send no-store cache headers.

bug_description: profile page keeps loading forever when the connection drops.

screenshot.description: Page showing an endless spinner over the profile.

steps_to_reproduce: Disable the network in DevTools and reload
root_cause: The loading flag is reset only in the success branch, not when the promise rejects.
resolution: Reset the loading state in a finally block and show an error message with a retry button.

bug_description: Reports with a long date range return a gateway timeout. I tried clearing the cache but it did not help.

screenshot.description: Report page with the message 'Request timed out'.

root_cause: The query filters on 'status' which has no index, causing a full table scan.
resolution: Add an index on 'status' and paginate or pre-aggregate the report data.

bug_description: The banner image is missing on nested pages. Please fix ASAP.

screenshot.description: Page with broken image icons where the banner should be.

steps_to_reproduce: Wait for the page to finish loading
root_cause: The image URL is relative (img/banner.png) and resolves incorrectly on nested routes.
resolution: Use an absolute path or the CDN base URL for static assets.

bug_description: Hi team, dark theme: sidebar links has very low contrast. Please fix ASAP.

screenshot.description: Dashboard in dark mode with dark grey sidebar links on a black background.

steps_to_reproduce: Switch the theme to Dark in settings
root_cause: The sidebar links uses a hard-coded color (#333) instead of the theme color token.
resolution: Replace the hard-coded color with the theme token and verify WCAG AA contrast.

bug_description: I get 'Unauthorized' on /api/profile shortly after the access token expires. Started after the last update.

screenshot.description: Dashboard showing 'Session expired' while still logged in.

steps_to_reproduce: Wait until the access token expires (15 min)
root_cause: Parallel requests each trigger a token refresh; the first one rotates the refresh token, so the others use a revoked token.
resolution: Implement a single-flight refresh queue so only one refresh request is sent.

bug_description: On my phone the Promo offer popup stays on screen and blocks the whole page. It happens intermittently.

screenshot.description: Mobile screenshot with the 'Promo offer' modal covering the screen.

console_logs: Uncaught TypeError: modal.close is not a function
steps_to_reproduce: Open https://shop.example.com/orders on a mobile device
Tap the X button in the corner
Observe that the modal remains open
root_cause: The mobile browser version lacks HTMLDialogElement.close() and no polyfill is loaded, so the close handler throws.
resolution: Add a dialog polyfill or use a custom close method that toggles the open state.

bug_description: Hi team, payments are recorded twice in the admin panel. Not sure if it is related to my account.

screenshot.description: Admin payment list with two identical rows.

console_logs: (server log) WARN webhook event evt_a91f processed twice
steps_to_reproduce: Wait for the payment provider webhook
root_cause: The webhook endpoint has no idempotency check, and the provider retries delivery after a slow response.
resolution: Store processed event IDs and ignore repeated deliveries; respond quickly and process asynchronously.

bug_description: Urgent: Admin user gets 'Access denied' after logging in with SSO. Started after the last update.

screenshot.description: Admin page showing '403 Forbidden' for a user who is an admin.

root_cause: The role claim is missing from the JWT issued through the SSO flow, so authorization falls back to 'user'.
resolution: Map SSO groups to application roles when issuing the token and add a test for SSO logins.

bug_description: Hello, the mobile navigation opens and closes immediately, so it can't be used. This happens every time.

screenshot.description: Mobile header where the mobile navigation flickers and closes.

steps_to_reproduce: Observe it toggles twice and ends closed
root_cause: The toggle listener is registered both in the component and in a global script, firing twice per tap.
resolution: Remove the duplicate listener and register events in one place.

bug_description: [/reset-password] The password reset link still works after it has been used.

screenshot.description: Reset password page opened a second time with the same link.

steps_to_reproduce: Open the link on https://learn.edu-demo.org/reset-password and set a new password
root_cause: The reset token is not invalidated after use.
resolution: Make tokens single-use, store a used flag and invalidate older tokens.

bug_description: Right after registration the profile page says user not found. Started after the last update.

screenshot.description: Profile page with 'User not found' immediately after signing up.

steps_to_reproduce: Get redirected to the profile page
Observe 'User not found'; refresh after 5s works
root_cause: The read request goes to a replica that has not yet received the newly inserted row (replication lag).
resolution: Read from the primary right after writes (read-your-writes) or retry with a short backoff.

bug_description: FYI - Some records are never shown because the page count is too low.

screenshot.description: Order list pagination showing 4 pages while 41 records exist.

root_cause: Total pages is calculated with floor(total / size) instead of ceil.
resolution: Use Math.ceil(total / size) and add boundary tests.

bug_description: Since this morning: Validation message under postal code does not disappear. Started after the last update.

screenshot.description: Form with a red error under the postal code field although the value is valid.

root_cause: The error state is only recomputed on submit, not on the change event.
resolution: Re-run validation on change/blur and clear the error when the value becomes valid.

bug_description: Hi team, late evening orders appear on the next day's report (UTC+7). It happens intermittently.

screenshot.description: Daily report where 23:30 orders are listed under the next date.

steps_to_reproduce: Create an order at 23:30 local time
Observe the order under the next day
root_cause: Dates are stored in UTC but grouped by UTC day while the UI displays local time.
resolution: Convert timestamps to the user's timezone before grouping.

bug_description: Clicking the Continue button does nothing.

screenshot.description: Page with the 'Continue' button highlighted; DevTools shows a red TypeError.

console_logs: Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'addEventListener')
steps_to_reproduce: Observe that no request is sent and the page does not change
root_cause: The click handler is bound before the 'Continue' element is rendered, so querySelector returns null and no listener is attached.
resolution: Check that the element exists before binding and attach handlers after the component has mounted.

bug_description: Customers receive two confirmation emails for one payment. It happens intermittently.

bug_description: [/settings/profile] Changing bio shows a success message, but the change is not stored. Started after the last update.

screenshot.description: Profile page with a green 'Saved' toast and the old bio after refresh.

steps_to_reproduce: Click Save and see the success message
Reload the page and observe the old value
root_cause: The update endpoint whitelists writable fields and 'bio' was not added to the list, but it still returns 200.
resolution: Add 'bio' to the writable fields and return 400 for ignored or unknown fields.

bug_description: Hello, large file (8 MB) upload is rejected. Started after the last update.

screenshot.description: Upload dialog showing 'Upload failed' for a 8 MB file.

root_cause: The reverse proxy limits the request body to 5 MB while the UI allows up to 20 MB.
resolution: Align the proxy and application limits and add a client-side size check with a clear message.
